decision: Qualify TQP-22 for the deterministic horizontal CPU visibility and residency reference while retaining TQP-21 as implemented pending human review of the corrected observatory render.
reason: TQP-22 passes fixed-view frustum and conservative occlusion fixtures, LOD and HLOD selection, draw and memory accounting, origin-shift and teleport invariance, stale edit rejection, a calibrated CPU performance window, provenance, and explicit non-claims. TQP-21 passes its coordinate, texture-array, normal-reorientation, LOD-continuity, and CPU contract tests, but renderer qualification remains fail-closed until the corrected deterministic 3x3x2 observatory image is accepted.

TQP-22 LOD and HLOD representation selection
TQP-22 reference draw-submission and retained-buffer accounting
TQP-22 origin-shift, teleport, edit-version, and stale-buffer behavior
held_scope: TQP-21 remains implemented until terrain_observatory_reference.png receives an explicit human ACCEPTED or REJECTED decision
explicit_non_claims: no vertical multi-layer visibility or residency qualification
no Godot renderer occlusion or GPU draw qualification
no production memory, frame-time, HLOD, texture, or shader budget
